zh.title: 華航前四川航空3架A350是買的還是租的？年報與重大訊息揭露購機契約
zh.summary: 華航2025年年報將與ILFC Ireland Limited簽訂的3架A350-900交易列為「購機契約」，2026年3月重大訊息亦明確使用「購價總額」，顯示這三架前四川航空航機由華航購買引進；12億美元為公告金額上限，並非實際成交價。
body: 中華航空於2026年陸續引進三架原由四川航空營運的Airbus A350-900，隨著B-18923在10月22日正式投入載客服務，三架航機究竟是由華航買下，或僅以租賃方式引進，也成為航空迷關注的問題。對照華航對外發布的重大訊息與2025年年報，這筆交易屬於購機，並非單純承接四川航空原有租約。
最直接的證據來自華航2025年年報的「重要契約」及重大契約簽訂說明：年報將ILFC Ireland Limited列為交易對象，三架A350-900列在「購機契約」項下，並記載華航於2025年12月5日簽約購置三架A350-900。該年報將購機契約與其他航機的「租賃契約」分開列示，兩者在文件中的分類相當清楚。
華航在2025年11月7日公告引進三架A350-900，交易對象為ILFC Ireland Limited，揭露交易總金額不超過12億美元。2026年3月11日補充公告進一步寫明「購價總額不超過美金12億元」，資金來源為自有資金及銀行融資。必須注意，這是揭露的交易金額上限，不能直接推算成三架飛機的實際成交價格，更不應將12億美元平均分成每架4億美元並視為確定售價。
三架航機的前身分別為四川航空B-304U、B-301D及B-304V，轉入華航後的註冊編號依序為B-18920、B-18922及B-18923。公開機隊履歷顯示，這批A350在四川航空服役時原本採租賃方式營運，之後經退租及交接程序轉入華航。也因此，「川航退租」與「華航購機」描述的是不同營運階段，不宜混為一談。
從機隊策略觀察，這三架A350可補強華航廣體客機運能。華航原於2025年6月規劃引進五架A350-900，後於2026年3月公告調整為三架，另兩架因策略因素取消；已完成的三架購機計畫，則隨航機陸續進入華航營運體系而逐步落實。對於購買或租賃的疑問，最具參考價值的仍是華航年報與公開資訊觀測站重大訊息，而非僅憑飛機過往的租賃紀錄判斷。

en.title: Did China Airlines Buy or Lease Its Three Ex-Sichuan A350s? Corporate Filings Point to a Purchase
en.summary: China Airlines' 2025 annual report lists three A350-900s from ILFC Ireland Limited under aircraft purchase contracts. A March 2026 regulatory disclosure also describes a purchase-price ceiling of US$1.2 billion, not a confirmed final transaction price.
body: China Airlines introduced three Airbus A350-900 aircraft formerly operated by Sichuan Airlines during 2026. After B-18923 entered passenger service on October 22, questions arose over whether the trio had been purchased or leased. The airline's annual report and stock-exchange disclosures identify the transaction as an aircraft purchase rather than a continuation of Sichuan Airlines' former leases.

The clearest evidence appears in China Airlines' 2025 annual report. Under significant contracts, it lists ILFC Ireland Limited as the counterparty for three A350-900s in the aircraft-purchase category. The report also states that China Airlines signed a contract to purchase three A350-900s on December 5, 2025. Purchase contracts and aircraft leases appear in separate categories in the report.

In a material disclosure dated November 7, 2025, China Airlines identified ILFC Ireland Limited as the counterparty and set a transaction ceiling of US$1.2 billion for the three aircraft. A supplementary disclosure on March 11, 2026, explicitly referred to a purchase-price ceiling and specified internal funds and bank financing as funding sources. The disclosed ceiling is not the final sale price, and dividing it by three would not establish the actual price of each aircraft.

The aircraft previously flew with Sichuan Airlines as B-304U, B-301D and B-304V, and subsequently received China Airlines registrations B-18920, B-18922 and B-18923. Public fleet histories show that Sichuan Airlines operated the aircraft under leases before returning them. Those earlier leases and China Airlines' later purchase describe different stages of the aircrafts' ownership and operation.

The acquisitions provide China Airlines with additional widebody capacity. An original June 2025 plan to introduce five A350-900s was reduced to three in a March 2026 disclosure, with the remaining two cancelled for strategic reasons. For the purchase-versus-lease question, the airline's own annual report and securities disclosures offer stronger evidence than descriptions of the aircrafts' previous leasing arrangements.
